features.name: Excel Reports for Finance (Generally Available)
features.description: Seven Excel reports made generally available for finance including trial balance, consolidated trial balance, accounts receivable, accounts payable, collectibles, receivables and payables with new modernized designs and layouts.
features.status_evidence_quote: made the Excel reports that were in preview generally available

features.name: Aged Accounts Receivables Excel Report
features.description: An Excel report with printable version and three analytical worksheets allowing analysis by local currency period, foreign currency, and currency codes with pivot tables and slicers.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is just one of of the finance reports that is now generally available in version 20 25 release Wave 1
caveats: Requires enabling Power Query content in Excel for security reasons

features.name: Customer Top 10 Excel Report
features.description: New Excel report for sales showing top 10 customers with printable version and analysis worksheet featuring slicers for filtering on customer number or name.
features.status_evidence_quote: we also made gen generally available two new Excel reports or maybe four

features.name: Vendor Top 10 Excel Report
features.description: New Excel report for purchasing showing top 10 vendors with printable version, analysis worksheet with slicers, and visual element that updates when vendors are selected.
features.status_evidence_quote: we also made gen generally available two new Excel reports or maybe four

features.name: Sales Order Performance Analysis Query
features.description: New query allowing flexible analysis of sales orders by joining sales header to sales line data, enabling grouping and analysis by customer and other dimensions.
features.status_evidence_quote: in sales and purchasing we also gave you a little bonus it will come in version 26.

features.name: Purchase Order Performance Analysis Query
features.description: New query for flexible analysis of purchase orders by joining purchase header to purchase line data, similar to sales order performance analysis.
features.status_evidence_quote: in sales and purchasing we also gave you a little bonus it will come in version 26.

features.name: Fixed Assets Excel Reports (Generally Available)
features.description: Three Excel reports for fixed assets made generally available: Fixed Assets Analysis, Fixed Asset Details, and Fixed Asset Projected Value with modernized layouts.
features.status_evidence_quote: we made three of the Excel reports or the three preview report reports in Excel generally available

features.name: Fixed Asset Ad Hoc Analysis Query
features.description: Query joining fixed asset ledger entries to fixed asset class, subclass and other fixed asset card data allowing flexible analysis of fixed asset transactions.

features.name: Sustainability Excel Reports with Updated Layouts
features.description: Three Excel reports for sustainability with updated layouts to match the modern design and feel of finance reports, providing improved analytics capabilities.
features.status_evidence_quote: we added in the last release wave through three Excel reports so they have already generally available but in this release wave we also

features.name: Legacy Excel Reports Deprecation
features.description: Legacy Excel reports are being phased out and moved to a Legacy group in the Excel Reports menu, to be removed in future release waves.
caveats: Will be removed in a later release wave
